description: The line plot, titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3," illustrates the sparsity ratio across different layers for three distinct cases: the sparsity ratio before the gate, the sparsity ratio after the gate, and the sparsity ratio after the average gate. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, scaled from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," starts at a value of approximately 0.01 at layer 0 and remains relatively flat, staying just above 0.00 throughout the layers. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," begins at a high value of approximately 0.8 at layer 0, then sharply declines to a value of around 0.05 by layer 10, and continues to decrease gradually, stabilizing near 0.02 by layer 22. The green dash-dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080," starts at approximately 0.3 at layer 0, declines rapidly to about 0.05 by layer 5, and then continues to decrease more slowly, ending at a value of approximately 0.01 at layer 22.
